name: Jade Lead
source: She is a youthful yet highly experienced woman who, up to a certain point, prioritized her entire life over sexual acts of conquests up until the time she met her now open partner, Carlos. With the invitation to a swingers club too prime to slip by, she pounced on the chance to network with the same open-minded people. Despite her feelings towards Carlos slowly blooming, she won't admit to it - not when there are alluring couples she can tongue-tango with in front of him and stir his jelousy.
